title: Microteaching (TS12)
journeyNote: Teaching a class is one thing. Teaching while being evaluated is another.

keep.title: What I'd keep
keep.text: My original fish-hook game. Learners explained the serving rules themselves, so even in a short demo the lesson stayed student-centered. I also finished the discussion.

redo.title: What I'd redo
redo.text: Time. I ran out of it and never reached the assessment. Next time I will rehearse with a timer and fit the activities into 45 minutes.

evaluatorFeedback: Properly implemented the use of ICT (fish hook game); maintain students interaction; stated clear objectives; well prepared instructional materials; DLL is ready; Loud and clear voice; polite, confident, and smiling; connected the lesson to science and health; 'congratulations'.

deliverables.title: Full TS12 Compilation (Rubrics, DLP & Slides)
deliverables.description: Complete compilation including official evaluation rubric scoring, detailed procedural lesson plan, and slide deck visuals.

deliverables.title: Detailed Lesson Plan (DLP Only)
deliverables.description: Full procedural lesson plan outlining Restaurant Serving Sequence objectives, instructional sequence, and activities.

deliverables.title: Presentation Slides
deliverables.description: Visual presentation aids and slides utilized during the evaluated classroom demonstration.

deliverables.title: Fish-Hook Recitation Game Screenshot
deliverables.description: Custom interactive software application created to randomize and engage learners during recitation.
